name: create_task_from_feedback
title: Open a card from a feedback mark
description: Decide a feedback mark by opening a new card from it; the mark's screenshot becomes its attachment and the answer gives the card key. The reply (optional) goes into the mark's thread for the marker. A mark that waits for the owner is refused.

description.description: Markdown: what the marker saw, the page and what to change.
